title: ParityCases
description: A capture case file: the character fixtures to run and the UI actions to perform on each.

startupDelaySeconds.description: Extra wait after the main window first reaches stable bounds.

settleMilliseconds.description: Paint interval after each navigation step and the bounds-stability window.

sequences.description: Named action lists that other action lists can include.

buildActions.description: Actions for characters in build (creation) mode.

careerActions.description: Actions for characters in career mode.

path.description: Fixture path relative to the case file.

CharacterMode.description: build: the character is still being created; career: <created> is True.

CaseAction.description: One UI action. selectTab and capture use name; include uses name (a sequence); waitFor uses label; wait uses milliseconds; optional applies to selectTab only.
